correctness.rationale: The three-component map is exactly the finite P(k,q)-weighted Eq. (19) generalised to nondecreasing C1 f,g. The state cube is invariant because each row weighting sums to one. On a candidate two-cycle, segmentwise FTC yields secant Gram A,B,C with AC-B²>=0. The first two swap equations give ΔU=(-b)[C+a(AC-B²)]/(1+aA) ΔY; group-response monotonicity supplies ΔG=EΔU+HΔY with E,H>=0, hence (1+H+EK)ΔY=0 and all increments zero. For pointwise J, det(sI+J)=s(s+aA)(s+H)+E(-b)[sC+a(AC-B²)]>0 for every s>0. The converse example uses P(1,1), a=d=0, b=c=1, f=g=1/2(1+tanh(m(x-1/2))), m>2: two distinct fixed levels of the scalar sigmoid form a prime-two orbit with monodromy 0,rho²,rho²<1; hyperbolicity continues it to an open strictly-positive parameter region. Independent fresh exact rational Gram test: AC-B²=784/1875 and det(sI+J)=43172143/13500000 at s=7/6; direct numerical determinant agrees. Independent sigmoid checks at m=2.5,3,6 gave two-step multipliers 0.38333913,0.15548276,0.00093103. The finite checks corroborate but the algebra proves the quantified claim.
